instrumentation_scope: Test-only caller-thread RAII poison/counter at the actual native libc::socket construction site; no global counter and no effect on unscoped/other-thread construction. A caught constructor poison plus subsequent counted successful admission validate the probe and unwind restoration. This proves the socket-constructor obligation for the exercised public prompt_arguments authority refusals only, not universal absence of filesystem, process or other I/O. The post-ack hook is also thread-local/scoped and cfg(test, unix), runs after outcome/delivery/native_prompt_acceptance/native_message_id are all assigned, and raises real SIGINT synchronously before final cancellation observation. Both new parent tests invoke exact ignored helpers in separate Rust test processes; helpers are implementation details, not independently counted coverage. Neither instrumentation path exists in release builds.
